HOW THE EVENING GOES
Your guests end up in the show.
Chef arrives early to set up and stays at least an hour; bigger parties run longer.
01 · ARRIVAL & SETUP
Grill set up before your first guest arrives
Our chef brings the portable teppan, propane, utensils and all ingredients. You set the table where you want the party to happen.
02 · LIVE COOKING & SHOW
Dinner is cooked in front of everyone
Fried rice, vegetables and two proteins per guest, cooked hot and served straight from the grill, with the tricks, jokes and games that make hibachi fun.
03 · GUESTS JOIN IN
Your only job is hosting
Choose the interaction level that fits your crowd, from family-friendly to full party mode. When it is over, we clean up our station and leave.

Quick answers
Is the rate the same on weekdays?
Yes. $55 per adult any day, any start time. Below 10 adults the $550 minimum applies. Parties of 60 or more adults: from $45 per adult, show included, games not included.
Is the $100 refundable?
Reschedule free up to 72 hours before your date. Inside 72 hours the $100 is not refunded, but it applies to a future booking.
What if it rains?
A covered patio or an open garage works. If conditions are not safe, we reschedule with no penalty.
